title: Six Years of Hands-on Clinical Laboratory Experience.
title_accent: A Journey Through Laboratory Science and Research
text: I am a Microbiology graduate from Primeasia University and currently working as a Medical Laboratory Technologist at Islami Bank Hospital and Cardiac Centre, Mirpur, Dhaka. With over six years of professional experience, I have gained hands-on experience in microbiology, hematology, biochemistry, immunology, molecular diagnostics and transfusion medicine. Working closely with clinical specimens and diagnostic procedures has strengthened my interest in laboratory-based research, particularly molecular procedures, clinical microbiology and transfusion safety. Combining practical laboratory experience with published research, I am motivated to pursue postgraduate studies and further strengthen my research skills and scientific understanding.

cards.title: Research Interests
items: Clinical diagnostic & microbiology - Exploring pathogen identification, laboratory-based diagnosis and advanced diagnostic approaches for infectious diseases.
Molecular Microbiology & Genetics - Understanding microbial genetic diversity, gene regulation, molecular mechanisms of pathogenicity and bacterial adaptation.
Molecular Diagnostics - Exploring PCR-based detection, real-time PCR, multiplex assays and emerging molecular technologies for infectious disease diagnosis.
Microbial Biofilms & Pathogenesis - Understanding biofilm formation, microbial virulence, persistent infections and their role in antimicrobial resistance.
Host-Pathogen Interactions - Exploring microbial pathogenesis, host immune responses and the molecular mechanisms underlying infectious diseases.

cards.title: Academic Goal
cards.text: To pursue advanced education and research in microbiology, molecular diagnostics, and infectious diseases, contributing to scientific progress and improved public health.
cards.note: Seeking: M.Sc./ PhD opportunities and research positions in Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Clinical Microbiology and Laboratory Medicine.
